summary: The agent successfully completed the economic time series correlation task by combining wide-format annual matrix data with long-format monthly updates. Key patterns to capture: (1) Wide-format matrices (years as columns) require different handling than long-format panel data, (2) `status_flag` is a common alternative column name to `release_status` in statistical releases, (3) The skill needed explicit guidance on averaging partial-year monthly data when combining historical annual series with current-year monthly updates. No new skill directory needed—updating the existing economic-time-series-correlation skill with these variant patterns.
